description: Add F10 shortcut to open dot menu; add keyboard accelerators for menu (you can navigate by pressing F10 and then the underlined letter corresponding to the menu entry -- basic functionality in Qt apps)

comments.body: I think it might be better to put the mnemonic on M of Markdown. In general it should better to not need a separate key for enable/disable or show/hide.
This is a dialog title, it should not have a mnemonic.
I don't think it makes sense to add a mnemonic to a tool tip.
